evidence: The paper identifies metabolites through univariate differential analysis and network-based partial correlation pruning: "To build a consensus network, we identified the most redundant metabolites found in all of the patients' signatures." Random Forest models were then applied post-hoc: "To test the discriminatory power of this signature, Random Forest models were tuned for every possible combination of metabolites from the Consensus Network." No variable importance scores are reported; Random Forest is used only for classification validation with AUC-ROC metrics, not for feature selection or ranking.
